profile.headline: AWS Certified Developer and Solutions Architect | Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: A seasoned Full Stack Software Engineer with extensive experience leading complex software development projects across diverse industries, including healthcare, finance, and blockchain. He has a strong background in Java and cloud-based technologies, with a proven track record of improving legacy systems, enhancing code quality, and implementing scalable software solutions. Known for his leadership, problem-solving, and commitment to best practices, he brings both technical depth and collaborative energy to every team he joins

positions.title: Product Engineer
positions.description:
Pioneered automatically generated, container-level (C4 model, C2) architecture diagrams driven from the service registry and regenerated via GitHub Actions on every merge to main, giving teams continuously up-to-date visibility into the live system architecture

Built a robust, extensible internal API serving both customer support and analytics needs, enabling structured access to customer and insurance-product data for third-party AI workflows and internal reporting 

Championed domain-driven design across the platform, architecting properly bounded contexts and driving deeper Platform API test coverage to move the system away from a distributed-monolith pattern toward a cleaner, genuinely distributed architecture

positions.title: Full Stack Developer (Sr. Consultant)
positions.description:
The skillset used here includes:
• Led project and team on foundational work for versioning of a distributed legacy system across
multiple timezone, by managing Team Daily Stand-ups and Sprint Planning for Team as Scrum Master
and Team Lead both in unofficial and official capacity.
• Responded and solved issues that occurred with sensitive client data within different services for
multiple clients concurrently (AWS, Datadog, Java).
• Maintained and improved legacy systems by reducing bugs, improving development and QA process,
and overall introducing better functionality and documentation practices in normal practice.
• Introduced test coverage and code quality across 80% of legacy code-base (over some 2 Million lines
of code).
• Conceptualized and collaborated in efforts to introduce better framework and process for regression
and integration testing for work going forward.
• Introduced private Maven and NPM repository artifactories in AWS CodeArtifact for reduction of code
duplication and overall improvement in code quality by 40%

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working together with both clients and internal team members to build solutions using the company's proprietary Track-and-Trace software; Saga. Also played a major role in improving, maintaining, and building internal company programs (payment and licensing server and workflow). 

The skillset used here includes: 
• Functioning as a team-leader on projects, designing them from the ground up utilizing systems diagrams from a behavioural driven design perspective 
• Test-driven development which helped with defining time and tasks across sprints in our agile process 
• Utilizing development tools such as Docker, Git, JMeter, Postman, Artillery, and more to facilitate continuous development of projects 
• Prototyping solutions to work closely together with the clients 
• Strong development focused around Java for building solutions for clients; utilizing various creational design patterns (factory, prototype, abstract factory, and singleton patterns), structural design patterns (composite, adapter, and proxy patterns), and behavioural design patterns (chain of responsibility, command, and observer patterns)
• Full suite of testing with the goal of high (90% +) test coverage across unit, integration, and end-to-end testing; utilizing Junit and Selenium

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Tutoring a junior Software Engineer while building solutions for the country's Ministry of Health in assisting their re-opening of Curacao to tourists in the midst of COVID.

Also played a core role in updating their proprietary bank transaction system which used SWIFT ISO15022 to utilize SWIFT ISO20022.

The skillset used here includes: 
• Working closely with a small team to design projects' structure utilizing behavioural driven design; building out systems design and component design diagrams
• Prototyping solutions for government clients with a focus of building out requirements and specifications quickly and confirming the demands of the clients
• Utilizing Github for versioning but performing builds and updates manually to hosting services done through DigitalOcean's containerization services
• Utilized both Java and NodeJS heavily on the backend as well as VueJS and ReactJS heavily on the front-end. Also dabbled in Flutter very briefly
• Researching, identifying, and utilizing REST API tools for easier development such as ExpressJS, Strapi, and Quarkus
• Working with relational-SQL databases for projects such as PostgreSQL and SQLite
• Utilizing Jest, Mocha, Chai, and Yup for testing as well as validation across NodeJS/Javascript backend systems while using JUnit and Mockito across Java backend systems

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Spearheaded a small team to build a cloud-based solution tool as a Proof of Concept for students to use throughout their entire academic life.

The skillset used here includes: 
• Worked with colleagues to designsystem diagrams, IPO charts, IaaS scripts (both for CloudFormation and Terraform), and documentation detailing setting-up cloud-based systems and relevant credentials
• Utilized Python and Java on AWS' tools (Lambda, API Gateway, and Aurora) to create a full cloud-based system

positions.title: Blockchain Engineer
positions.description:
Worked within the blockchain space to build, maintain, and improve tools for the Aion Ecosystem as a part of the team in Barbados. This included working and managing the Aion-flavoured Web3, the Aion Wallet, and the in-house block explorer.

The skillset used here includes: 
• Working closely with team members to design, build, and maintain internally focused projects by building out prototypes focusing on key requirements defined in discussions and meetings
• Utilizing Jenkins to maintain an automated build-pipeline for testing, staging, and releasing projects throughout the SDLC
• Researching and utilizing any language/framework needed (such as AWS, Web3, NodeJS, ReactJS, C#, Java, Springboot, and Scala) to build projects based on defined requirements and sepcifications.
• Worked closely with Atlassian suite of tools; Jira and Confluence, for internal task management and documentation.
• Object-oriented design practices utilizing SOLID and KISS principles throughout SDLC
• Designed, maintained, and worked on multi-faceted distributed systems with indriect relations to the blockchain kernel and offline C#-based wallet
• Modelling and designing database and solution architecture for optimized performance on solutions; utilizing partitioning on the database level, caching on the API, datametrics acquired through micrometer and datadog at all levels, or building out views/modals on ReactJS to minimize/optimize caching of pages
• Helped shed-light and demystify the field of blockchain technology to interested parties by speaking at conferences and workshops
